name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold exploration and development company advancing its flagship Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina. Diablillos is a significant silver-gold deposit that received formal approval under Argentina's RIGI investment incentive regime in 2026, with a construction decision targeted for the second half of 2026. The company is in the late-development stage, conducting Phase VI drilling to extend high-grade mineralization at the JAC zone.
